## Context

- **CSRF** matters for **cookie-based** sessions and **HTML forms** using session cookies. Pure JWT-in-`Authorization` APIs often skip CSRF; OxyRoute should offer an **optional** building block for mixed or server-rendered apps.
- See [Feature gaps](https://github.com/QueryaHub/OxyRoute/blob/main/docs/feature.md#4-безопасность-кроме-jwt).

## Direction

- Options: **double-submit cookie**, **synchronizer token** in form + server store, or integration notes with a session library.
- Safe defaults: constant-time compare, `SameSite` cookie guidance, reject missing token on mutating methods when enabled.

## Acceptance criteria

- Document threat model (when CSRF applies / when it does not).
- Pytest for at least one pattern (e.g. token mismatch → 403).

## Research

- Starlette CSRF middleware patterns; OWASP CSRF Prevention Cheat Sheet.
